artworks.title: Avenue of the Allies
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a city street scene. The artwork shows a vibrant urban environment with large flags hanging overhead and people moving along the street. The buildings have detailed architecture and there are many figures engaging in different activities on the sidewalk, creating a dynamic and populated area. The sketch uses loose, expressive lines to give it an energetic feel, capturing the essence of a lively street life.

artworks.title: The French Cruiser
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a ship on a body of water. The ship is depicted with bold, dark brushstrokes and a prominent mast. In the background, there is a dark landmass with some vertical elements and the silhouette of buildings. The water is depicted with horizontal brushstrokes, creating a textured surface. The overall color palette is gray tones against a light background.

artworks.title: Plazza del Comune, Pistoia
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image shows a large stone building with arched entrances forming a horizontal line about a third from the top of the composition. The building's facade features repeated arch patterns and rectangular windows with balconies above. Several figures are scattered across an expansive open space; one person is mounted on a horse, while others stand in small groups or interact in pairs. The technique used involves fine, etched lines of varying density to create depth and texture in the building and figures. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of brown and sepia, giving the image an antique, slightly faded appearance that enhances its classic and historical feel.

artworks.title: A Winter Poem
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a winter landscape with a high horizon showing snow-covered hills, leafless trees, and two snow-topped structures below. The scene is detailed with fine, linear brushstrokes creating a crosshatched texture. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray. In the foreground, there are patches of snow around a reflective body of water, with sparse, bare trees on both sides.

artworks.title: Kilcreggan
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with cottages, trees, and surrounding foliage. The horizon is low, with a line of trees running along it. Two buildings are slightly off-center to the right, surrounded by dense clusters of trees. The detailed rendering features textured brushstrokes that emphasize shadows and contours in the foliage and rooftops. The color palette is monochromatic, creating depth through contrast between dark lines and lighter shades. The shading and line work give the scene a serene atmosphere, leading the eye smoothly across the composition.

artworks.title: Charles Balthazar Julien Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.artist: Max Rosenthal, after Charles B.J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust portrait of a man in profile, shown from the chest upwards. He is facing left, with a prominent nose and high forehead. His hair is neatly styled, appearing wavy and combed back. He is wearing a dark coat with a high, stiff collar and a white cravat tied around his neck. Surrounding him is an elaborate oval frame with decorative elements, including a crest featuring a lion above the man's silhouette. The background features ornamental motifs and architectural elements, with flourishes and carved figures adorning the lower part of the frame. It is shaded, adding depth to the portrait.

artworks.title: Farm with a Large Tree (La Ferme au Grand Arbre)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a tree trunk on the right side with branches extending upward. A small house with a sloped roof and chimney is seen in the distance, partially hidden by hills. The horizon consists of gentle, horizontal lines with soft clouds in the sky. The etching uses intricate brushstrokes to create textures in the landscape, from grass and rocks to cloud shading. The color scheme is monochromatic with black and sepia tones, giving the scene a timeless and contemplative quality.

artworks.title: Wayfarer Surprised by a Storm (Le Voyageur surpris par l'Orage)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The etching shows a figure in motion, set against a detailed sky filled with swirling patterns. In the background, there are distant landforms. The foreground features a figure in a hat and coat amidst textured ground. Stylized trees on the left add contrast to the image. The artwork is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between light and dark elements.

artworks.title: Man Squaring Logs (Homme qui fend des bûches)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. In the foreground, a man is bending over working on a log. His figure is depicted with detailed cross-hatching. Beyond him, a few felled logs are scattered. The background consists of a dense thicket of trees. The trees are depicted with vigorous, textured strokes that convey depth and density. The color palette is monochromatic, with rich, dark shades of black and gray. The artwork showcases intricate cross-hatching, creating a dynamic texture and emphasizing the interplay of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Siesta of a Laborer (Sieste d'un Ouvrier)
artworks.medium: drypoint with etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person leaning forward with their upper body resting on a table. Their head is down, resting on crossed arms. Facial features are not visible. The person has short tousled hair, wearing a shirt with rolled-up sleeves and pants with crisscross lace pattern along the calf area. A chair is partly visible beneath and to the side of the table. On the table, there is a large mug or tankard and a hat placed beside it. The background consists of simple, straight-lined patterns indicating shading or texture, lacking other details or scenery.

artworks.title: The Large Shepherdess (La Grande Bergere)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing in a field, holding a stick and looking down. They wear a hooded cloak that obscures their face. The cloak is flowing and reaches the ground. In the background, there are sparse trees, grassy hills with grazing sheep, and a larger animal, possibly a dog.

artworks.title: Alphonse Legros, No. 1
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows the head of an elderly man with a large beard and thick, slightly unkempt hair. The man has a neutral expression with eyes looking straight ahead. He has full eyebrows and a broad forehead. The background is plain. There are no accessories or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Union Square
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows an urban scene from an elevated point of view, overlooking a park with tall buildings in the distance. The horizon is blocked by the buildings. The drawing is done in a pointillist style with tiny dots forming the image. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and gray on an off-white paper. Trees with bare branches are in the foreground, along with walking paths and small figures in the park. Prominent buildings with architectural details are visible in the distance against a lighter sky.

artworks.title: Flatiron Building
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a busy urban setting with tall buildings reaching into the sky, creating a vertical composition. The horizon is obscured by the merging structures and sky. The style features sketch-like brushstrokes, primarily made of fine, linear marks that imply movement and texture, akin to a pencil or charcoal drawing. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray providing a delicate presence. People are depicted as small, dark shapes close to the viewer, indicating a lively street scene, while architecture in the distance is lighter and more diffused against softly rendered clouds.

artworks.title: The Times Building
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level perspective of a city street with tall buildings on both sides. There is a tower building in the center right adorned with decorative detailing. The style is a pencil sketch with soft brushstrokes for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray against a light paper background. There are smaller figures near the viewer, with mid-sized buildings and a narrowing view in the distance.

artworks.title: Old and New Mills, Valenciennes
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a landscape with a windmill on the left side and an industrial complex emitting smoke on the right. The windmill is detailed with wooden textures and angular sails, while the background shows low-lying structures and smoke stacks. The color scheme is black and gray, creating a subdued atmosphere.

artworks.title: Corner of a Wood (Coin d'un Bois)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of E. Gerald Lamboley, 1993)
artworks.description: The image shows a row of tall trees on the left side, leading the view towards hills and mountain formations. The intricate cross-hatched lines create texture and depth in the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white, emphasizing sunlight filtering through the trees and illuminating certain areas in the landscape.

artworks.title: The Forest
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a forest on the right side, leading to a body of water in the distance surrounded by hills. The brushstrokes are soft and blended, creating an ethereal atmosphere. The color palette consists of warm sepia tones. In the background, there are deer grazing near the water.

artworks.title: Whistler's House at Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank with small boats moored along the water's edge. A bridge extends to the right, leading to structures and foliage in the distance. The artist uses detailed linework in the etching to create texture and depth. Buildings with chimney-topped roofs are seen near the boats, suggesting an urban setting. The color palette is monochromatic, using only shades of black and white. There are figures interacting with the boats near the water, adding a sense of human presence to the scene.

artworks.title: Jean in a Black Hat
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1934)
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome sketch of a young girl sitting. She faces slightly to the left with her hands resting in her lap. She wears a large dark hat with a band, and her long hair is visible under the hat. She has delicate facial features, a neutral expression, and forward gaze. The girl wears a light gown with detailed neckline and a dark, voluminous cape with textured material. There is an ornate chair back behind her on the left. The background is plain, highlighting the girl as the focal point of the image.

artworks.title: The Pine Bough
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a slightly elevated side angle. The horizon is not distinctly visible, but the line where the water meets the sky creates an implied horizon in the background. Two silhouetted figures are depicted, one seated on a rocky outcrop and the other reclining slightly further back, both partially obscured by dark foliage. The artwork appears to be created with pencil or a similar medium, featuring soft, textured, and wispy brushstrokes that give a dreamy quality to the scene. The color palette consists of various shades of gray, highlighting the contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Keokuk, Chief of the Sacs and Foxes
artworks.artist: Alfred Hoffy, after Charles Bird King
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in a full-length portrait. The individual on the left is seated slightly behind the other person, with a hand on the other's shoulder and holding a staff with feathers. They have dark hair styled into a mohawk with red accents and feathers, deep-set eyes, and prominent cheekbones. The person is adorned in ceremonial attire, including a feathered headdress, a cloak, and beadwork, with a large medallion around their neck. In front sits a younger person with dark hair, bead necklaces, a medallion, lighter-colored clothing with beadwork, and red leggings. Both are seated on rocky terrain with surrounding greenery, against a neutral backdrop showcasing the vivid colors and intricate details of their attire.

artworks.title: Qua-Ta-Wa-Pea, A Shawnoe Chief
artworks.artist: Albert Newsam, after Henry Inman, after Charles Bird King
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Jefferson Patterson, 1979)
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a person in a seated position. The individual has a serious facial expression with distinct facial features, characterized by high cheekbones and slightly narrowed eyes. They have medium-toned skin and dark hair peeking out from under a red, patterned cap. The person is wearing a blue garment with white trim, a white ruffled shirt underneath, and a red ribbon around their neck holding a large silver medallion featuring a profile of a person's head. The background is plain and light in color, highlighting the figure in the foreground with no additional objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Capitol at Washington
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view of the Capitol building in Washington, D.C. The view is slightly elevated, providing a detailed look at the architecture. The sky is light with subtle clouds. The drawing style is precise with fine lines and shading techniques. The color palette is mainly blacks, whites, and grays, with hints of color in figures and trees. Figures in period clothing are shown close to the Capitol, some walking or conversing. A horse-drawn carriage and additional people are included. Trees in the distance frame the building on the right side.
